provenance.label: Street frontage
provenance.method: DataSF street centerlines of classcode 2 to 5 (major, arterial, collector, residential) off the paper, private and pseudo layers, matched to the DataSF parcel outline. A lot fronts a segment (depth 0) within 40 m when the part of its boundary within its distance plus 2 m of the segment is at least 5 m long and the line from that edge’s midpoint to the segment crosses no other parcel by more than 0.5 m. A lot is one lot deep (depth 1) when it shares at least 3 m of boundary with a lot fronting the segment and its own line to the segment crosses that lot, and no other, by more than 0.5 m. Thresholds are tier 4.
